name_en: Shaoxing Rensheng Textile & Garment Co., Ltd.
main_products: Chiffon crepe, chiffon silk, charmeuse print, poplin, organdy embroidery
woven_evidence: Its main products, chiffon, crepe, poplin, charmeuse and organdy, are woven constructions.

canton_fair.evidence_note: Its Made-in-China profile says it shows new products at the 'Chinese Export Commodities Fair' (the Canton Fair) every year, without giving a year.

notes: It may be the same company as 浙江人生纺织服饰有限公司 (code 160Q913, men's and women's wear zone, Shaoxing 136th list), whose registered scope is distribution and import/export. That link is not confirmed. Its address is an office in Time Square, Keqiao. Contact: Mr. Tobby Zhao.
